items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Charles used to hire me on, he played myself.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I see. So he makes it both ways then. Oh yeah. And then the other people come.

He makes it both ways and they hurt me too. See, because we didn't even play the same instrument. I mean, Charles used to hire me on, he played myself. So that's kind of a hard shift for me but what I'm going to do, he's the boss.

That's right. Well I know when I first found John up about it, you know, to come to the Preservation Hall. Uh huh. But, alright, he told me some of the different places he played but I've forgotten different organizations he played for. Who were you playing most of your work for before Preservation Hall started? With the orchestra?
